description: Python 3.14.7 official macOS universal2 installer. Manual only because v1 platform predicates cannot enforce the documented macOS 10.15+ floor.
purpose: Offer a pinned Python runtime artifact for explicitly selected macOS projects while preserving any existing interpreter and project constraints.
detection: Before proposing, inspect only the participant-approved project declaration and existing interpreter version. If the existing interpreter satisfies the project declaration, do not select this recipe. Confirm macOS 10.15 or later; if the OS version is unknown, report manual/unmet. Never rewrite project constraints or lockfiles.
license_notes: Python software is licensed under the Python Software Foundation License Version 2. Python distributions can include components under other licenses; preserve vendor notices. This recipe does not repackage the artifact.
side_effects: No automated installation is supported by this record.
A participant-selected manual install may change machine-level Python aliases; do not proceed unless the destination and effects are reviewed and existing project versions remain intact.
verification: Manual/unmet until OS version is known and compatibility is confirmed. After a separately approved manual installation, verify the installed version at the explicit executable path; do not treat an unknown OS version as ready.
